items.headline: Palo Alto Networks launches Frontier AI Critical Defense Program to convert shared and AI-generated vulnerability intelligence into network-level protections

Multiple institutional investors disclose new or increased positions in Palo Alto Networks, including large stakes from OMERS Administration Corp, Clal Insurance Enterprises, Bank of Nova Scotia, and others
Cantor Fitzgerald and Benchmark maintain Buy ratings and raise price targets on Palo Alto Networks ahead of Q4 results
